data.why: The repo ships a real cascade-reservoir input workbook (data/sample/输入.xlsx, also served by GET /api/sample) that matches the exact multi-sheet schema (计算参数, 上游_水库信息, 下游_水库信息, inflow series) the optimizer expects, so synthetic data would risk a schema mismatch; a small hydro_api_helpers.py shim had to be written because api.py imports it from the author's private monorepo path which doesn't exist in this checkout.

goals: Upload a reservoir inflow/parameter Excel workbook and preview the upstream and downstream reservoir parameters before committing to a full optimization run
Run the cascade (upstream+downstream) hydropower scheduling optimization at a chosen calculation time step (daily/10-day/monthly)
Inspect the resulting water-level, inflow/release flow, and power-output time series as interactive charts
Download the computed scheduling results as an Excel workbook for offline analysis
Compare how scheduling outcomes change across different time-step granularities (日/旬/月)
Validate the optimizer against the bundled reference output (data/sample/计算结果.xlsx) using the bundled sample input

review.summary: The tree accurately records how the optimization is run and its results downloaded through the Swagger-only backend, and every screen I opened matches its node. However, it leaves out the review of results that the README makes central (parameter preview, water-level/flow/power charts), spends a phase on service health checks, and presents an unconfirmed daily re-run with an identical output size as a success, so it needs fixes before filing.
